main_text.head: שבר
main_text.p: [Hebrew forms] Ch. Simplex, fatuus, stultus. Syr. [Hebrew] Quòd rudis, imperitus est, ad Hebr. 5.13. Plural. [Hebrew]. Fœmin. [Hebrew] Stulta, Proverb. 9.13.
[Hebrew headword] Ch. Stultitia, Fatuitas, Simplicitas, Prov. 1.22.
[Hebrew headword] Ch. Cæcitas, per antiphrasin: est enim à [Hebrew] Clarus, purus. Plur. emphat. [Hebrew] Cæcitates, id est summa & densissima cæcitas, Genes. 19.11. Hebraicè [Hebrew].
main_text.head: שבש
main_text.p: Ch. Expandere, extendere, dilatare ramos, Psalm. 80.12. Pahel [Hebrew] Perplexum reddere, intricare, implicare: Turbare, confundere, seducere, pellicere, Ithpahel [Hebrew] Perplexum, Attonitum, Obstupefactum esse vel fieri: Seduci: Implicari, Contorqueri.
[Hebrew forms] Ch. Ramus, ramus tener, furculus, propago, palmes: Syr. [Syriac] Joh. 15.2.4.6.
[Hebrew] Pahel Ch. Germinare, frondescere, repullulare, Jobi 14.7.
[Hebrew] Ch. [Hebrew text], Legitur Gen. 3.14. in T. Jon. Locus est suspectus, & pravus procul dubio. Potest verti: Et cutis tua erit in projectionem
